title: Projects, Knowledge and Connectors
description: Project instructions and knowledge, sharing roles, connectors like Gmail and Drive, and skills.

cards.definition: Chats in one project do not share context with each other unless the information is saved in the project's knowledge base.
Directions saved in a project that apply to every chat in it, such as a tone, a role or task rules, unlike account-wide instructions.
An account-wide setting (profile instructions) that applies to all your conversations, for general preferences rather than project-specific context.
Documents, text or code uploaded to a project that Claude uses as context in every chat in that project.
On paid plans, Claude automatically retrieves only the relevant parts of project knowledge once it nears the context limit, expanding capacity by up to 10x.
Clear, well-named project files help Claude find and retrieve the right information, especially when RAG mode is active.
Team and Enterprise projects can be private to invited members or public to the whole organization, while individual chats stay private unless shared.
A sharing role that lets members read a project's instructions and knowledge and chat in it, but not change them.
A sharing role that lets members change a project's instructions and knowledge, update members and contribute, beyond what viewers can do.
Links that let Claude reach apps and services to retrieve data and take actions, using only the access your own account already has.
Lets Claude search and read email and draft messages; by default it asks your approval before each send, reply or forward.
Lets Claude search and retrieve Drive files, but it extracts text only and does not process images embedded in documents.
Team and Enterprise owners can set connector tools to always allow, need approval or blocked, for example allowing reads while blocking writes.
Packages of specialized knowledge and workflows that Claude picks up on its own when relevant, such as built-in ones for Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PDF.
A skill you build for your own process by packaging a folder containing a skill.md file as a ZIP and uploading it, private until shared.
Install skills only from trusted sources, since they can carry prompt-injection or data-exfiltration risk, and review bundled files before enabling one.
PDFs up to 100 pages are read for text and visuals; 101 to 1000 pages are read as text only; longer PDFs cannot be uploaded to a chat.
A chat accepts up to 20 files of 500MB each, while project files are limited to 30MB each and everything must fit in the context window.
A pre-built Ask Your Org project on Team and Enterprise that searches connected tools like Slack, Microsoft 365 and Drive and returns cited answers once an Owner sets it up.
Each person signs in to the connected tools with their own account, so results follow their own permissions, except custom connectors using a shared key.
